barnet.name: Barnet
barnet.notes: Barnet publishes neither zone boundaries nor a zone hours list online; its interactive map is at barnet.traffweb.app.
barnet.licence: Zone hours: Barnet council. Borough outline: Office for National Statistics / London Datastore (OGL v3).

charges.note: No borough-wide tariff found; Barnet sets pay-by-phone tariffs per street/location by traffic order. Example (Naylor Rd, Birley Rd, Swan Lane N20, from 31 May 2026): £2.19 for up to 60 minutes, 2-hour max, Mon–Sat 8am–6.30pm. A 2026 HA8 order (Dryfield Rd/Gold Hill) is reported at £3.38/hour (not verified).

bd.name: Barking & Dagenham
bd.notes: Hours come from the council’s map data; there is no hours list on its website. School zones have no hours in the data.
bd.licence: Zones: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham map data (licence not stated). Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: As of the July 2024 amendment: first hour free in all on-street pay-by-phone bays (must still be registered with PayByPhone; one free session per day). Beyond that, 7 CO2 bands; Band 1 (0–50 g/km) £0. Tariff TC1 (town centre): up to 2h £5.50–£6.60, up to 4h £12.00–£13.00 by band. Tariff TC2: up to 2h £2.20–£2.80, up to 4h £3.40–£4.50. Non-Euro-6 diesel surcharge £0.20–£1.10 per session. Which zones use TC1 vs TC2 not established. Could not confirm these are unchanged in 2026.

bexley.name: Bexley
bexley.notes: Bexley publishes its zones as a road-by-road table, so zones are drawn as those roads (from OpenStreetMap). Where only part of a road is in a zone, the map shows the part near the zone’s other roads; the council’s table gives the exact extent. Abbey Wood 1 (AW1) and West Heath (WH) aren’t in that table, so they aren’t drawn. Hours are from the residents’ permit charges table.
bexley.licence: Zone roads and hours: London Borough of Bexley. Streets: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: RingGo price; pay-and-display machines (where present) are 10–30p dearer. Most on-street locations (Bexleyheath, Sidcup, Welling) charge £2.10 for 1 hour. Exceptions: Erith £1.90/hour (Walnut Tree Road £1.70); Abbey Wood bays (Mon–Fri 11am–1pm only) £15.40 for 2 hours, a commuter deterrent. No diesel or emissions surcharge mentioned. Tariffs are per street, not per CPZ.

brent.name: Brent
brent.notes: Zones near Wembley Stadium have extra event-day restrictions.
brent.licence: Zones: Brent Council CPZ map data (licence not stated). Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: Same rate in every zone checked: 20p minimum for up to 15 minutes, then 10p per 3 minutes (= £2.00/hour, £4.00 for 2 hours). No emissions or diesel variation on the RingGo tariffs. A 2026–27 opposition budget amendment proposing emissions-based charges is not adopted policy.

bromley.name: Bromley
bromley.notes: Only the town-centre zones (A, B, C) are drawn: the council publishes a map for those alone, so the rest of the borough is outlined and tapping it lists every zone. They are traced from the council’s Bromley Town Centre CPZ map (2021), placed by its 1:11,372 scale and matched to road junctions in OpenStreetMap (about 7 m). The Bromley North Village restricted parking zone has its own map and isn’t drawn.
bromley.licence: Town-centre zone boundaries traced from Bromley Council’s “Bromley Town Centre CPZ” map; hours from that map’s signs and the council’s permit page. Borough outline: Office for National Statistics / London Datastore (OGL v3). Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: Set street by street (council directory 'On-street parking in Bromley', ~200 records). Examples: Bromley town centre (South St 6037, North St 6008, Queens Rd 6025, Elmfield Park 6010) £2.30/hour, 2h max; Park Road, Bromley £1.80; Beckenham Albemarle Rd (6067) £1.00/hour; Orpington Augustus Lane (6042) £1.20; Chatterton Rd (26100) £1.10. No emissions/diesel element found. Visitor vouchers £45–£55 per book of 15.

camden.name: Camden
camden.notes: Hours come from the council’s CPZ map data, last edited October 2026.
camden.licence: Zones: Camden Council (the council gives no warranty as to accuracy). Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: Camden charges paid-for parking by street-based tariff area (not by CPZ) and by vehicle emissions, plus an air-quality surcharge for older petrol/diesel cars. New rates took effect 1 April 2026 and a further rise 1 October 2026 (notice TMO2526-0040 dated 12 March 2026). The official figures could not be read (see gaps), so no numbers are given.

city.name: City of London
city.notes: The whole City of London is one controlled parking zone.
city.licence: Boundary: City of London Corporation; © Crown copyright and database rights 2022 OS 100023243. Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: Mon–Fri 8am–7pm. 'electric' = electric, hydrogen or hybrid; 'petrol' = petrol registered from 2005; 'diesel' = diesel registered from 2015; older vehicles (and anything else) £10.00/hour. Saturday 8am–11am £2 for any duration; free after 11am Saturday, Sundays and bank holidays. Page updated 19/10/2026; a consultation proposes Mon–Sat 7am–8pm charging from May 2027.

croydon.name: Croydon
croydon.notes: Zone boundaries are traced from the council’s 20 permit zone maps (PDF), each placed by matching its street names to OpenStreetMap (median error 2 to 13 m per map). Several maps are old (2007 to 2021), so boundaries may have changed since; where two maps overlap, the newer one is used. The council doesn’t publish zone hours (they’re on the signs at each zone entrance), so zones are grey except where a map states its hours.
croydon.licence: Zone boundaries traced from Croydon Council’s permit zone maps. Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: From 7 April 2026. Other bay types, per hour Band 1/2/3: Central/East Inner/East Outer/West 2-hour bays £3.18/£3.61/£4.25 (plus Sunday & 6pm–midnight £1.76/£1.99/£2.35 in Central); Croydon CPZ 4-hour £2.36/£2.67/£3.15; District 2-hour £1.91/£2.16/£2.55; 8-hour standard £1.12/£1.27/£1.50; 2-hour 'first hour free' bays £0 for the first hour. Non-Euro-6 diesels pay Band 3 (no separate surcharge). RingGo displays the Band 3 price. Visitor half-day permits: inner zones £2.60–£3.40, outer zones £1.60–£2.20.

ealing.name: Ealing
ealing.notes: Ealing publishes each zone as a list of streets, so zones are drawn as those streets (from OpenStreetMap), not as areas. Where the council lists only part of a street (some house numbers, “between … and …”), the map shows the part near the zone’s other streets; check the zone page for the exact numbers.
ealing.licence: Zone street lists and hours: Ealing Council. Streets: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: Each PayByPhone location has one of three on-street hourly tariffs ('Hourly rate 2', '5' or '6'; 352/255/46 locations). Bands above are rate 2, the commonest. Per band 1–4: rate 5 £1.87/£2.43/£2.99/£3.36, rate 6 £2.60/£3.88/£4.11/£4.86. Pre-Euro-6 diesels pay a NOx-charge column instead (rate 2: £1.35/£1.68/£2.01/£2.28; rate 6 top £5.19), i.e. roughly +£0.21–£0.38/hour. tierByZone = the tariff of locations whose street matches the zone's street list (approximate). Spreadsheet's tariff sheet is headed 'New Traiff From 21th Oct 2026'. Council: 'Discounts of up to 50%' via PayByPhone/PayPoint for all but the most polluting vehicles.

enfield.name: Enfield
enfield.notes: Zone boundaries and hours come from the council’s own CPZ map data (KML). “Excluded area” polygons refer to traffic orders and have no hours.
enfield.licence: Zones: Enfield Council CPZ map data (licence not stated). Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: Same tariff in all areas, Monday to Saturday (and Sunday in Enfield Town): 15 min 90p, 30 min £1.70, 1 hour £3.30, 2 hours £6.50; North Middlesex Hospital area 3h £8, 4h £9. No emissions or diesel element. Event-day visitor permits: books of 10 for £21.

greenwich.name: Royal Greenwich
greenwich.notes: The council says its map is a guide only and may not be up to date. Zones marked * are run by a neighbouring borough. Most zones don’t apply on bank holidays; see each zone’s council page.
greenwich.licence: Zones: Royal Borough of Greenwich CPZ map data (licence not stated). Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: Three location tariffs with base (pay-and-display / highest-emission) 1-hour prices £3.10, £6.20 and £8.30; pay-by-phone discounts for vehicles under 255 g/km CO2, down to £1.10/hour for 0 g/km on the cheapest tariff (e.g. 76–90 g/km: £1.60 / £3.10 / £4.20). Which zones use which tariff isn't stated (price shown in the PayByPhone app). Visitor vouchers: typically £26 for 5 all-day / £13.50 for 5 half-day in daytime zones, £13.50 for 10 in short-hours zones.

hackney.name: Hackney
hackney.notes: Outside the controlled hours you don’t need a permit, but yellow lines and disabled bays still apply. Some streets have different restrictions; match-day and bank holiday rules differ. Check the sign on the street.
hackney.licence: Zones: Hackney Council, Open Government Licence v3.0. Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: Hackney charges by price band (zone) and vehicle type. Band 1 = A, B; Band 2 = C, D (central), E, F, G, G2, H, J; Band 3 = D (south), K–Y. Band 4 around Homerton Hospital (part of N): £1.95 / £2.50 / £3.65 / £4.65. One-hour minimum charge. Zone D left out because the app's D (1)/D (2) don't map clearly to the council's D (central)/D (south) price bands.

haringey.name: Haringey

charges.note: Diesel vehicles pay a 30% surcharge. The event-day-only CPZs have no on-street price listed.

haringey.notes: Zones near Tottenham Hotspur Stadium and Finsbury Park have extra restrictions on event days.
haringey.licence: Zones: Haringey Council map data (licence not stated). Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

harrow.name: Harrow
harrow.notes: Harrow: normal parking and CPZ rules apply on bank holidays. The exact hours are on the entry signs of each zone.
harrow.licence: Zones: Harrow Council; © Crown copyright and database rights 2021 Ordnance Survey 100019206. Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: Harrow prices each street by tariff zone (from 1 July 2026): Metropolitan £3.30, Major £2.20, District £1.50, Local £1.10 per hour. First hour free once a day at one on-street location (session must be started). Some District streets have a capped rate (e.g. £11.90 over 3 or 6 hours). Many streets are 'Pay and Display Zone' outside CPZs.

havering.name: Havering
havering.notes: Havering publishes each zone as a list of the streets whose residents can have its permits, with the zone’s hours, in its Parking Permit Zones Lookup. Each zone is drawn around those streets in OpenStreetMap, so it shows where the zone is rather than its exact edge. Where only part of a street is listed, only the part near the zone’s other streets is drawn. Where single yellow lines in a zone run longer than its bays, that extra time is shown as unknown. Street names are matched to OpenStreetMap; a few listed streets couldn’t be found there and aren’t drawn, and GP6 (Stanley Close) isn’t drawn because the borough has more than one.
havering.licence: Zone streets and hours: Havering council (Parking Permit Zones Lookup). Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: On-street tariff is by duration, not a strict hourly rate: up to 1 hour £2.60, 1–2 hours £4.40, 2–3 hours £6.20 (Romford streets). First 30 minutes free once a day borough-wide, except Romford. No charge on Sundays. Christmas Day is free.

hf.name: Hammersmith & Fulham

yellowLines.single: No waiting during the times on nearby signs. With no sign, the zone’s controlled hours apply.
yellowLines.loading: You can usually stop briefly to pick up or drop off passengers on either, unless kerb marks or signs ban loading. Blue Badge holders can park on yellow lines for up to 3 hours where there’s no loading ban and no obstruction.

charges.note: RingGo pay-by-phone rates for on-street pay and display bays. Resident visitor permits are cheaper.

hf.licence: Zones: LBHF. Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

hillingdon.name: Hillingdon
hillingdon.notes: Hillingdon calls its zones parking management schemes and publishes their hours only in traffic-order notices.
hillingdon.licence: Zone hours: Hillingdon council. Borough outline: Office for National Statistics / London Datastore (OGL v3).

charges.note: Non-resident rates, which most areas share: up to 30 min £1.30, 30 min–1 hour £2.50, up to 1.5 hours £4, up to 2 hours £5.50, then 80p (residents) / £1.40 (non-residents) per extra 20 or 30 minutes depending on area. Uxbridge town centre is £1.40 per 15 minutes (about £5.60/hour; residents 80p per 15 minutes). Residents (HillingdonFirst card) pay less: 30 min free, £1.50 up to 1 hour. Hayes (Mount Road/Nield Road), Harlington and parts of Uxbridge South/Hillingdon charge £1.40 per 20 minutes (£4.20/hour) for non-residents. Usual hours are Mon–Sat 8am–6.30pm, but they vary.

hounslow.name: Hounslow
hounslow.notes: Zones traced from the council’s interactive CPZ map (its map images are placed exactly, about 2 m per pixel) and named from its own pop-ups. Some zones aren’t drawn because their outlines on that map aren’t closed (around Bedford Park, Central Chiswick and Lampton): there the borough is outlined instead. The council says its map is guidance only.
hounslow.licence: Zone boundaries traced from Hounslow Council’s interactive CPZ map; hours from its pop-ups. Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: Pay by phone, priced per half hour by CO2 band (bands 1–7, from 28 Feb 2025); table runs to 5 hours. Diesel and diesel-hybrid surcharge £0.20 per half hour (£0.40/hour). Unchanged by the 2026/27 fees notice (effective 6 June 2026), which says charges it doesn't list stay the same. Some park-and-shop places give 30 minutes free (session still needed).

islington.name: Islington
islington.notes: Zone boundaries traced from the council’s CPZ map (GeoPDF, version 34), which it calls a guide only; expect edges to be out by up to about 20 m. Nine zones have extra match-day restrictions.
islington.licence: Zone boundaries traced from Islington Council’s CPZ map; hours from the council’s CPZ page. Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: Base price is £4.25–£7.30/hour depending on location (per-street RingGo tariffs; e.g. Agdon Street 61001 is £7.30/hour). Mon–Fri 10am–1pm adds up to £1.05 peak surcharge (not in zones G, HE, TW, U, Z). Fuel surcharge per hour on top: petrol/hybrid 1–185g/km £2.30, 186–225g/km £2.85, over 226g/km £4.26, diesel £7.45; EVs pay the base price. Zone C standard tariff £6.90/hour. Match-day controlled bays £14.15/hour. Visitor e-vouchers £4.55/hour (£2.25 discounted for residents) plus fuel surcharge.

kingston.name: Kingston upon Thames
kingston.notes: Zones and hours from the council’s restrictions map (AppyWay Streets), which gives each zone’s areas their own hours; the council’s web page lists the same hours. Parking permit areas (DB–DK) are permit holders only during their hours.
kingston.licence: Zones and hours: Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames restrictions map (AppyWay). Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: Kingston prices each RingGo location (from 11 April 2025): £2.10–£3.90/hour. Ashdown Road/Fife Road 26508 £3.90). Some locations include 30 minutes free (CPZ S central, H, C). V is £2.30 (4 hour stay, 26567) or £2.10 (no max stay, 26552). RingGo adds a 10p convenience fee.

lambeth.name: Lambeth
lambeth.licence: Zones: Lambeth Council map data (licence not stated). Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: From 26 March 2026. Price depends on zone group, CO2 band (A–M, same bands as resident permits) and time: peak 10am–1pm costs about 10% more. Diesel vehicles pay a surcharge of about 75% (e.g. Central band A £9.94/hour instead of £5.68). First 15 minutes is charged at 25% of the hourly rate. Robertson Street/Cavendish Road (shared with Wandsworth) is cheaper: band A £3.84 off-peak.

lewisham.name: Lewisham
lewisham.notes: Zone boundaries traced from the council’s “Parking restrictions in Lewisham” map (vector PDF), placed by fitting its ward boundaries to Lewisham’s (median error under 1 m); zone edges follow the map’s dotted lines. Hours from the council’s table published 15 January 2026.
lewisham.licence: Zone boundaries traced from Lewisham Council’s parking restrictions map; hours from the council. Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: PayByPhone, by CO2 band. Standard CPZs: band 0 (EV) £1.74 up to band 5 £4.64/hour. Town centres (Lewisham Central B1/B2, Blackheath Village BHA, Rushey Green East L, Deptford Town Centre S) since 1 April 2025: £2.79–£5.69. Diesel that isn't Euro 6 compliant pays £2.62/hour more in every band. Charged pro rata in 15-minute steps up to 1 hour.

merton.name: Merton
merton.notes: Pay-and-display-only areas without a zone code are not shown.
merton.licence: Zones: Merton Council map data (licence not stated). Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: From 21 April 2026: Wimbledon town centre roads £5.40/hour, most northern zones £3.60, the south of the borough and Wimbledon Common roads £1.80. Paying by phone/internet adds a 20p fee. Some RingGo locations give the first 20 minutes free. No per-hour emissions or diesel surcharge found for on-street parking.

newham.name: Newham
newham.notes: Zones marked “Event Day Parking Zone” have extra restrictions on event days at the London Stadium.
newham.licence: Zones: Newham Council map data; contains Ordnance Survey data © Crown copyright. Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: Short-stay rates per hour; 30-minute-max bays charge half (Tier 1 £1.00 to Tier 5 £2.80 per 30 min, diesel +£0.50). Engine size is used where CO2 isn't on the V5C.

rbkc.name: Kensington & Chelsea
rbkc.notes: These are the borough’s resident parking control areas (Control 1 to 8). Single yellow lines follow the borough’s two larger CPZ areas instead; check the signs.
rbkc.licence: Zones: Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea (CC-BY per data.gov.uk). Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: Hourly PayByPhone rates depend on the street's tariff area (Basic/Low/Medium/High, shown on the council's March 2026 tariff-area map; these areas are not the residents' control areas) and fuel type. Diesel costs £0.40–£1.00/hr more than petrol depending on tier. PayByPhone adds 10p per session. No visitor vouchers are issued.

redbridge.name: Redbridge
redbridge.notes: Permit parking doesn’t apply on bank holidays in Redbridge, but waiting restrictions and pay-and-display do. Check the signs: operating times change.
redbridge.licence: Zones: Redbridge Council “My Redbridge” map data (licence not stated). Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: First hour free once per day in on-street pay and display bays, then a per-location RingGo tariff. No emissions or diesel tiers shown on the sampled RingGo pages.

richmond.name: Richmond upon Thames
richmond.notes: Zone boundaries traced from the council’s “Controlled Parking Zones (CPZs)” map (vector PDF, https://www.richmond.gov.uk/media/0zsnuisk/zone_all.pdf), placed by fitting its borough boundary to Richmond’s (median error about 7 m); zone labels matched by their pointer lines. Pay and display zones M3–M9 and the Twickenham event zone (R) are not drawn.
richmond.licence: Zone boundaries traced from Richmond upon Thames Council’s CPZ map; hours from the council. Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: Prices from RingGo, checked 2026-11-19: Richmond raised charges around 29 June–8 July 2026 and its own tariff page still shows 2025/26. Per hour: A1 and A2 £4.70 (Clarence Street 5404, King Street 5411, Chiselhurst Road 5401, Royston Road 5430); Zone D area £2.80 (Heath Gardens 5477, Lion Road 5497); X £1.50 (Vicarage Road 5566, Upper Teddington Road 5580; the council's old inner/outer split isn't shown on RingGo); every other zone sampled £1.95 (B, C, CR, H, HM, KA, L, N, S, SH, SH/WT, T–T6, WT, Z5). Residents get up to 30 minutes free or discounted. Max stays vary by street (1 to 10 hours), so check the sign or the app.

southwark.name: Southwark
southwark.notes: Zone boundaries from the council’s Southwark Maps viewer. Hours from the council’s parking zones page, except Nunhead and Rotherhithe Village, which aren’t on that page (hours from the map data).
southwark.licence: Zone boundaries: Southwark Council map data. Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: From 1 April 2026: £8.60/hr in C1, C2, D, F, G and GR, £5.70/hr in all other CPZs. Diesel vehicles pay £13.40 or £9.20/hr in total (a £4.80 or £3.50 surcharge). Visitor permits: a single 1-hour virtual session is £3.00, or £18.15 for 10 one-hour sessions (about £1.82/hr), per the council's 5 March 2026 fees notice. The council's 'street parking bays' page still shows the older £7.80/£5.10 rates, so it's out of date.

sutton.name: Sutton
sutton.notes: Only Sutton’s controlled parking zones are shown; its permit parking areas (permit holders only, street by street) are not.
sutton.licence: Zones: Sutton Council open data (WFS). Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: Sutton town centre on-street pay and display uses RingGo tariff areas 'Central Zone' (£3.00 per 30 min / £6.00 per hour) and 'Outer Zone' (£2.00 per 30 min / £4.00 per hour). No diesel or emissions tiers on the sampled RingGo pages. The Central tariff page was last updated 16 May 2024 and the Outer one 1 June 2026.

towerhamlets.name: Tower Hamlets
towerhamlets.notes: Hours are from the council’s parking zones page; the map data itself has none.
towerhamlets.licence: Zones: © Crown copyright and database rights 2025 Ordnance Survey, London Borough of Tower Hamlets AC0000820594. Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: 2026/27 cashless on-street rates (page published 25 Aug 2026). Diesel vehicles pay a higher total rate (a £3.00–£3.40/hr surcharge). Resident visitor vouchers are £3.90 per day (not hourly). RingGo for B1 Roman Road still shows diesel at £8.30/hr (last updated 15 Aug 2025), so RingGo may lag the council table for diesel. One hour free parking around markets on market days (book via RingGo).

walthamforest.name: Waltham Forest
walthamforest.notes: Zones and their core hours are from the council’s “Controlled Parking Zones Overview Plan” PDF: each zone is drawn on it as its own shape, labelled with its code and hours and coloured by the hours key. The map is placed by fitting its borough boundary to Waltham Forest’s (median error about 5 m). The council says some streets in a zone have different times, so check the signs.
walthamforest.licence: Zone boundaries and hours from Waltham Forest Council’s CPZ overview map (December 2025 revision). Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: Cashless (PayByPhone) on-street: 30 min £1.70, 1 hour £2.70, 3 hours £4.40, so longer stays are cheaper per hour. Pay and display machines in the Walthamstow High Street area: 30 min £1.90, 1 hour £2.90. No diesel surcharge or emissions banding mentioned.

wandsworth.name: Wandsworth
wandsworth.notes: Zone boundaries from the council’s “Controlled Parking Zones in Wandsworth” map (vector PDF), placed by fitting its borough boundary to Wandsworth’s (median error under 5 m). Sub-zones (a, b) are the map’s; hours are the council’s current web pages, which agree with the map except D2b (the web page says Monday to Friday). Roads accepting two zones’ permits (A1/A2, A1/A3, A1/A5, AO) are listed but not drawn.
wandsworth.licence: Zone boundaries traced from Wandsworth Council’s CPZ map; hours from the council. Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: Standard tariff £3.70/hr applies in most shared-use bays (max stay 4 hours or more). High tariff £4.30/hr applies to bays near town centres with 1–2 hour max stays. Low tariff £1.60/hr applies on some under-used streets (Birdhurst Rd, Blackshaw Rd, Grant Rd, Magdalen Rd, Maskell Rd, Podmore Rd, Spencer Park, Wimbledon Park Rd, Windmill Rd). Tariff follows the bay type, not the zone. The council page was last updated 03/06/2024, but RingGo 10612 (Tonsley Road, high tariff) still shows £4.30/hr. RingGo adds an 18p convenience charge. Battersea Park area (B) has its own stepped tariff on the council's Battersea Park page.

westminster.name: Westminster
westminster.notes: Zone boundaries traced from the council’s CPZ map, which dates from February 2011; boundaries may have changed since and edges can be out by about 20–60 m. Hours from the council’s March 2026 tariffs and controlled hours table; the colour follows paid-for bays and single yellow lines. Taxi and coach bays aren’t shown.
westminster.licence: Zone boundaries traced from Westminster City Council’s CPZ map (2011); hours from the council (March 2026). Streets, kerbs and machines: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

charges.note: Hourly paid-for bay rate by parent zone and CO2 band (bands 1–5), from 2 March 2026; each zone carries its own bands. Pre-2015 diesel vehicles pay an extra 50%. Motorcycles have a flat rate (A £4.70, B £3.81, C £2.16, D £3.15, E £6.52, F/G £6.83).
